phase: Phase 7 Pilot Activation Gate & Blocker Resolution

mandatory_pilot_blockers.title: Physical Safety Inspection at 4 Candidate Corridors
mandatory_pilot_blockers.action_required: Conduct daytime hazard surveys of walkways at Rasoolpura, Tolichowki, Cyber Towers, and RTC X Roads.

mandatory_pilot_blockers.title: Procure & Inspect Certified PPE & Calibrated Gauges
mandatory_pilot_blockers.action_required: Procure Class 2 safety vests, non-slip waterproof boots, and 3m fiberglass depth staffs.

mandatory_pilot_blockers.title: Deploy DPDP Consent Policy on Staging Portal
mandatory_pilot_blockers.action_required: Publish terms of service and coordinate coarsening verification on web portal.

mandatory_pilot_blockers.title: Formally Designate Field Lead & Safety Officer
mandatory_pilot_blockers.action_required: Issue formal institutional role appointment letters.

feed_specific_blockers.title: TSDPS AWS Data-Sharing Agreement
feed_specific_blockers.impact: TSDPS telemetry operates under historical/sandbox fallback; does not block manual vantage pilot.

feed_specific_blockers.title: GHMC DRF Incident Logs Access Agreement
feed_specific_blockers.impact: DRF calls must be manually entered by operator; does not block manual vantage pilot.

feed_specific_blockers.title: Municipal CCTV Access & DPIA Clearance
feed_specific_blockers.impact: CCTV is strictly quarantined under Vision V4 NO-GO readiness gate.
